result:
Root cause: `strip_reminders` in `anthrouter/request_text.py` didn't trim outer whitespace, though its docstring says it does. Removing the `<system-reminder>` block left a leading `\n`, so the `startswith(ACTIVITY_LABEL_PREFIX)` check failed.

Fix: `strip_reminders` now returns `.strip()` of the result. Every caller gets trimmed text, not just `is_activity_label_prompt`.

I ran your example and `is_activity_label_prompt` now returns `True`. I couldn't run the test suite: `pytest` isn't installed here and `make test` can't find `python`. So I haven't checked whether other callers or existing tests depended on the untrimmed output.
